provenance_note: Replayed 2026-08-26 after independent academic review, then changed-input rechecked after correcting the Garstang article, ORACC inscription identity, and British Museum canonical object locator.
reason_for_inclusion: Record locator coverage and bibliographic corrections without pretending URL resolution proves historical claim fidelity.
method: Retained unchanged prior outcomes and performed fresh redirect-following HTTP GET plus official-record identity checks for each changed locator: Garstang 1935 returned publisher access control, ORACC Q003496 resolved HTTP 200, and British Museum 124906 returned institution access control.

limitations: HTTP resolution and DOI metadata do not prove that a source supports a public claim.
Access-controlled results require an independent reviewer with lawful access or a browser-accessible abstract or catalog record.
The Garstang publisher URL and DOI metadata identify the directly relevant 1935 article but do not license ingestion of its text.
The release remains fail closed on any later independent claim-fidelity or citation-fitness failure.
